value.rationale: Exact source-specific triple-deletion ambiguity matters for synchronization-channel analysis. Despite general D3 bounds being known, an exact count for an entire run-constrained infinite class collapses to four run features and gives closed Fibonacci values and the density 8/phi^6. The class is motivated by classical finite Fibonacci words and forbidden-run source constraints, not by a chosen numeric slice. No general code capacity or downstream theorem is required for this self-contained structural fact.
